bio: This restaurant specialises in Spanish rice cuisine. Sample rice dishes from every region of Spain: paella, said to be from Valencia; clams and rice cooked in a clay pot, from Basque Country; and caldero, rice simmered in an iron pot, from Mar Menor. Gathering around a table and sharing the same pot captures the joy of Spanish food culture. The range of appetisers, including dry-cured ham and tapas, is impressive. ‘Panza’ means ‘pot belly’, and you’re sure to leave satisfied in both stomach and soul....
